9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Pacific View Site Activation Plan. Contact Person: Public Works Deputy Director Deane
1) Confirm that the proposed interim use of the site will be as a living museum or cultural center focusing on the local Encinitas arts community; 2) Direct staff to proceed with a solicitation for architectural services to provide design and engineering drawings (Preliminary Design Report / Plans) to rehabilitate the existing classroom and administration buildings to code-compliant habitable structures along with basic site plans to indicate where required parking would best be located and where passive use open space could be provided; 3) Direct the City Manager to work with the subcommittee to develop a Request for Proposals and Consultant Selection Criteria to engage a firm for the architectural services, and to bring a recommendation for which architectural firm to select to the Council for decision; 4) Direct the Pacific View Site Activation Subcommittee to work with staff and the selected architect to develop the process for conducting the rehabilitation work and report back to Council; 5) Approve the transfer of funds from 2014 Lease Revenue Bond debt service to the Pacific View Master Project (CP15C) in the amount of $480,000 and to the facilities maintenance budget in the amount of $20,000. The total of these transfers is $500,000.
2015-02-11 Item 10A - Pacific View Site Activation Plan
10B.
Sewer Asset Management Plan and Sewer Rate Study. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Hefner
1) Receive Sewer Asset Management Plan and Sewer Rate Study; and 2) Authorize Proposition 218 public hearing to consider adjustments to Cardiff Sanitary Division sewer service rates and to reaffirm existing Encinitas Sanitary Division sewer service rates.
2015-02-11 Item 10B - Sewer Asset Management Plan and Sewer Rate Study Findings

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
